products.name: Dell UltraSharp 32 4K QD-OLED Monitor (U3226Q)
products.summary: 31.5-inch 4K QD-OLED UltraSharp at 120Hz with Dolby Vision, 99% DCI-P3 / 94% Adobe RGB, Thunderbolt 4 (140 W) and daisy-chain.
products.description: The UltraSharp 32 4K QD-OLED (U3226Q) is Dell's first QD-OLED UltraSharp for colour-critical work. The 31.5-inch 3840 x 2160 panel runs at 120 Hz with 1,500,000:1 contrast and 1000-nit peak Dolby Vision HDR. Dell lists 99% DCI-P3, 94% Adobe RGB and 80% BT.2020 coverage with colour calibration, plus Thunderbolt 4 upstream with 140 W EPR power, a Thunderbolt 4 downstream port for daisy-chaining, two HDMI 2.1, DisplayPort 1.4, RJ45 and KVM. Its 3-year warranty covers burn-in.
products.keywords: dell ultrasharp 32 qd-oled 4k professional monitor thunderbolt u3226q

specs.inputs: Thunderbolt 4 upstream (140W EPR) + Thunderbolt 4 downstream, USB-C upstream, 2x HDMI 2.1, 1x DisplayPort 1.4, RJ45

products.priceNote: Dell.com US sale price listed on the all-monitors page on 2026-09-28; regular Dell price $799.99.
products.summary: 34-inch curved WQHD conferencing monitor with a 4MP webcam, speakers, 100Hz and a USB-C hub with 90 W power delivery.
products.description: The Dell Pro P 34 USB-C Hub Conferencing Monitor (P3426WEB) is a 34.1-inch 3440 x 1440 curved (3800R) IPS display at 100 Hz with 350 nits and 99% sRGB. It integrates a 4MP webcam and two speakers for video calls, plus a USB-C upstream port with 90 W power delivery, HDMI, DisplayPort 1.4, 1GbE RJ45 and a USB hub.

products.name: Dell PowerEdge R670 1U Rack Server
products.priceNote: Dell.com US 'Starting at' price for the default configuration of this model (configure-to-order).
products.summary: 17th-generation 1U two-socket Intel Xeon 6 rack server with 32 DDR5 slots (8 TB), EDSFF E3.S options and iDRAC10.
products.description: The PowerEdge R670 is a 1U, two-socket rack server for Intel Xeon 6 processors with up to 144 E-cores or 86 P-cores per processor and 32 DDR5 RDIMM slots (up to 8 TB). Front storage options include up to 16 EDSFF E3.S Gen5 NVMe drives, and it is offered in rear-I/O hot-aisle and front-I/O cold-aisle versions. Dell's starting configuration includes a Xeon 6 6507P, 2 x 64 GB RDIMM, an 8-bay SAS/SATA chassis with PERC H365i, a 960 GB SSD and dual-port 25GbE.
products.keywords: poweredge r670 17g 1u xeon 6 rack server dense compute

specs.cpu: Intel Xeon 6 Performance 6507P (8C/16T, 3.5 GHz) as configured; up to 2x Xeon 6
